summary.text: Vic Meyers is the Democratic candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 47 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Democratic primary on June 30, 2026.
He is a U.S. Army veteran who said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include privacy protections, public schools and rural health care.

paragraphs.text: Vic Meyers graduated from Pueblo South High School in 1986 and earned a bachelor's degree from Colorado State University Pueblo in 1995.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1986 to 1991, and in a Ballotpedia survey described himself as a veteran of the 101st Airborne Division.
He said he worked for the Colorado Department of Corrections for 17 years, holds a degree in mathematics and physics, taught in public school classrooms and served on his local school board.

Meyers said his priorities include prohibiting private surveillance tools on government property, strengthening public schools and rural health care systems, and supporting regional ranching and farming cooperatives through state-backed financing.
